ideas.pitch: A decentralized platform aggregating real-time energy consumption and waste metrics across University of Delaware campus buildings to optimize institutional sustainability.
ideas.title: Delaware Campus Carbon Footprint Aggregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact green-innovation winning pattern by tackling local sustainability metrics with a concrete multi-agent data ingestion pipeline.

ideas.pitch: An interactive graph intelligence tool that maps and scores compliance and financial risk for mid-Atlantic regional manufacturing suppliers.
ideas.title: Local Supply Chain Fraud & Risk Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven graph intelligence and risk-scoring architecture that secured first place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent dispatcher for local delivery cooperatives using secure milestone-based escrow on Base for reliable gig-economy fulfillment.
ideas.title: Autonomous Regional Transit Escrow Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning autonomous agent marketplace and USDC escrow architecture from the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutritional planning and dining hall integration assistant tailored specifically to university meal plans and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: Student Health and Campus Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the practical consumer-health utility and rapid API integration strategy that won first prize at the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard tracking localized automated software failures and algorithmic bias incidents using Poisson regression and calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: Regional AI Incident Forensic Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals proven successful at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.
